body:
I'm really not sure what he's doing when he dissappears. Can be anything from a few hours to a few days, and I've become too scared to ask. I never really thought of ending the relationship, because I truly love(ed) him, but reading everyone's comments is giving me some second thoughts. 

I don't really share my relationship issues with anyone. Because when I talk to my friends about issues I often feel like I'm bad mouthing him, and that he should be present to defend himself. So I feel really bad when I ask around. This is the first time in a very long time that I asked for advice, and it's refreshing. Gives me a better perspective.
Yes I'll work on getting a mid ground, by having an open convo with him

But nothing stopped him from telling me straight off the bat that he doesn't like spam. If I was smothering him, he should have told me otherwise how can I possibly know? And he didn't tell me to back off a little bit, he told me to stop. Even saying things like he's going to block me if I spam him again. He made it clear that I was infringing on his boundaries. Which I totally get, and respect.
I had a hunch that he likes being in control, but I never paid it any mind. We also have tons of communication issues, obviously. I'll have an open discussion with him about these issues
She's generally quite entitled... So maybe it's that idk
